177:t_1:411.en:
$$エイミー$$
「By the way, he learned even this word of thanks only after coming to Earth.」

177:t_1:412.en:
$$甲児$$
「After we took $$レド$$ and $$ガロード$$ and the others in as comrades, we left the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ and headed straight for the $$アメリア$$ Continent, but...」

177:t_1:413.en:
$$勝平$$
「And that's where we met the great $$神勝平$$ and company!」

177:t_1:414.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「What kind of introduction is that...!?」

177:t_1:415.en:
$$恵子$$
「There goes $$勝平$$ again, getting carried away...!」

177:t_1:416.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's been a while, $$勝平$$, $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$.」

177:t_1:417.en:
$$シン$$
「So you guys were on $$翠の地球$$ too.」

177:t_1:418.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So these kids were $$カミーユ$$'s friends too.」

177:t_1:419.en:
$$勝平$$
「Don't treat me like a kid, Big Bro. I'm $$神勝平$$, the main pilot of $$ザンボット３$$.」

177:t_1:420.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「I'm $$神江宇宙太$$. I look forward to working with you.」

177:t_1:421.en:
$$恵子$$
「I'm $$神北恵子$$. I fought alongside all of you in $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ and $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

177:t_1:422.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$神$$, $$神江$$, $$神北$$... You all have similar surnames, huh.」

177:t_1:423.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「They're cousins. And their clan is called the $$神ファミリー$$.」

177:t_1:424.en:
$$シン$$
「Aren't $$兵左衛門$$ and $$一太郎$$ with you?」

177:t_1:425.en:
$$恵子$$
「Grandpa and $$一太郎$$ are taking part in the Resistance on $$翠の地球$$.」

177:t_1:426.en:
$$宇宙太$$
「We joined up with the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ on $$万丈$$'s instructions.」

177:t_1:427.en:
$$勝平$$
「As for Big Bro $$万丈$$ himself, he's off flying around all over the place and hasn't even shown his face here.」

177:t_1:428.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Well, that's just like him, and that's all there is to say about it.」

177:t_1:429.en:
$$ガロード$$
「So we took $$セントラル・ベース$$ on the $$アメリア$$ Continent, but...」

177:t_1:433.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Could you be... the pilot of the Gundam with the mustache...」

177:t_1:434.en:
$$ロラン$$
「That's right. I'm $$ロラン・セアック$$, the pilot of the Gundam with the mustache... the $$ホワイトドール$$.」

177:t_1:436.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I joined partway through the battle to take $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

177:t_1:437.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If it weren't for the $$月光蝶$$ of $$ロラン$$'s $$ホワイトドール$$, we... might have been finished off by $$バルビエル$$'s poison...」

177:t_1:438.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So he got you too...」

177:t_1:439.en:
$$ロラン$$
「But $$バルビエル$$ abandoned $$セントラル・ベース$$ himself, said he was going to $$蒼の地球$$, and left.」

177:t_1:440.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then he came to $$蒼の地球$$, and we got hit by him too...」

177:t_1:441.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「By the way, $$ロラン$$... What are $$ソシエ$$ and $$メシェー$$ doing?」

177:t_1:442.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I didn't bring them... The fighting from here on will surely be harder and more painful than anything before.」

177:t_1:443.en:
$$ロラン$$
(It's only a feeling, but when I ride the $$ホワイトドール$$, I can tell...)

177:t_1:444.en:
$$ロラン$$
(But, Miss $$ソシエ$$... I will definitely survive and come back to you.)

177:t_1:445.en:
$$甲児$$
「After that we headed for $$蒼の地球$$, and the ones who joined us along the way were...」

177:t_1:446.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That group over there, huh...」

177:t_1:447.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Pardon me, if you please...! Pardon me, if you please!」

177:t_1:449.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Born unknown, parents unknown, raised in Mars's Valles Marineris canyon, the humble $$ノノ$$, a petty nobody, if you please!」

177:t_1:450.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Everyone in $c, please, let this $$ノノ$$ share a cup with you too!」

177:t_1:451.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Uh, y-yeah... For now, we've confirmed your intention to join $c.」

177:t_1:452.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Back off, $$ノノ$$. We'll never get anywhere like this.」

177:t_1:453.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I apologize, everyone in $c. Allow me to greet you properly once more.」

177:t_1:455.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We're the $$フラタニティ$$. We have no such thing as a leader.」

177:t_1:457.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's an organization that gathers children with so-called super... powers, the $$トップレス$$.」

177:t_1:458.en:
$$カシオ$$
「The $$フラタニティ$$ is run basically by children alone, and adults can't interfere.」

177:t_1:459.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Thank you for the explanation, $$カシオ$$.」

177:t_1:460.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Because as coach, I have to greet everyone in $c properly.」

177:t_1:461.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$コーチ$$... you're one in title only...」

177:t_1:462.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You just mentioned the word $$トップレス$$. Is that power used in combat?」

177:t_1:463.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Yes. Each person's ability has its own characteristics, though.」

177:t_1:464.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For example, mine is remote manipulation of matter, and $$ラルク$$ here has quantum transfer ability, and so on.」

177:t_1:466.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And the most important point is that our $$バスターマシン$$s are powered by the $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$ produced by the abilities of the $$トップレス$$.」

177:t_1:468.en:
$$エマ$$
「So you're saying your machines run on your own power?」

177:t_1:469.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Exactly. And that power is unrivaled in our world, and...」

177:t_1:470.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「it is also our greatest combat strength against the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

177:t_1:472.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I've heard from $$アルト$$ and the others that you are also fighting creatures called $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

177:t_1:473.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Although they seem to be different from the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ we knew before the $$新世時空震動$$ jumped us here.」

177:t_1:474.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even after the transfer, we made intercepting $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$ our mission and have fought day and night.」

177:t_1:475.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「In your world, was there any fighting force besides the $$トップレス$$?」

177:t_1:476.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「There was an organization called the $$宇宙軍$$. Some of them have been transferred to this world as well.」

177:t_1:477.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But it would be pointless to ask them for cooperation. Their main mission is intercepting $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$, and their composition is specialized for that.」

177:t_1:478.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Given that, there seems to be an unspoken understanding of mutual non-interference with the $$サイデリアル$$.」

177:t_1:479.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Under those circumstances, could you explain why you're joining $c?」

177:t_1:480.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Of course. We have no intention of hiding anything from comrades we'll be fighting alongside from now on.」

177:t_1:481.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(He's awfully smooth... We may need to be a little careful...)

177:t_1:482.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「First of all, we are the $$フラタニティ$$, and our right to act independently of the $$宇宙軍$$ is guaranteed. So this is purely our own will.」

177:t_1:483.en:
$$チコ$$
(Our, huh... Isn't it $$ニコラ$$'s will, more like...)

177:t_1:484.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「And as members of this world, we learned that Earth's humanity has enemies other than the $$宇宙怪獣|lc$$.」

177:t_1:486.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「That's right. We decided to fight them to protect Earth's humanity.」

177:t_1:487.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We would very much like to cooperate with you, who are at the center of that fight.」

177:t_1:488.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...We have no reason to refuse.」

神.evidence: Family name of Kappei Jin (神勝平); said bare by Banagher in a remark about the cousins' similar surnames.

神江.evidence: Family name of Uchuta Kamie (神江宇宙太); glossary has 神江家 = Kamie family.

神北.evidence: Family name of Keiko Kamikita (神北恵子); glossary has 神北家 = Kamikita family.

kept_omissions: 177:t_1:478: 'サイデリアルとは互いに不干渉' - who holds the unspoken non-interference with Sidereal (Space Force / Topless / both) is not stated; kept impersonal 'there seems to be an unspoken understanding of mutual non-interference with the Sidereal'.
177:t_1:440: Banagher's trailing '俺達も…' has no verb; rendered as 'we got hit by him too...' (inferred from Kamille's 438 and Loran's 439).
uncertain: Bare surnames 神 / 神江 / 神北 (Banagher, 422) have no glossary token; used $$神$$, $$神江$$, $$神北$$ with proposed English Jin / Kamie / Kamikita.
ヒゲのガンダム = 'the Gundam with the mustache' (433/434); dlg_2026_04 translates the same joke separately, wording may differ.
425: お爺さん rendered 'Grandpa' (Heizaemon, Keiko's grandfather per Shinn's 兵左衛門さん in 424).
420: よろしく頼みます rendered 'I look forward to working with you' (Uchuta introducing himself).
Most of rows 447-488 reuse Tengoku dlg_2013_01/02 (Green route) wording; Nono's self-reference uses $$ノノ$$ token where 2013 used plain 'Nono' in a few rows.
471: standalone '$$宇宙怪獣$$...' uses the capitalized token form (Amuro repeating the word).
